notes.title: 【Sneaky Update Time! ✨】
notes.content:
【Sneaky Update Time! ✨】
Hello sweeties~
We've got some super lovely updates for you today!
🎊 Temple quests are no longer playing hide and seek! Our little monk has finally found his way home - quests can now be displayed and submitted properly~
🌟 Added a cute little bell to the restaurant and right-click quick serving! No more food getting stuck in the void! (Chef's hair is finally safe!)
💝 The crafting system got smarter! It can now recognize pre-crafted items! No more "what's this?" confusion~
Love you all! Thanks for your continued support and suggestions! (◍˃̶ᗜ˂̶◍)✩
Feel free to drop by if you have any questions~

notes.title: 【Patch Notes】Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
【Patch Notes】Version 1.0.1
Dear Players,
We have released a patch that fixes several issues:
🔧 Bug Fixes:

Fixed tutorial button not responding
Fixed game freeze when returning to main menu after Week 1
Fixed inconsistent action points display across different scenes
Fixed unskippable cafe tutorial
Fixed issue where items couldn't be served to customers in cafe
Fixed invisible crops in farming system
Fixed fishing cursor jitter when pressing spacebar

🎯 Coming Soon:
We are working on improvements to the Student Council Quest system:

Optimizing quest entry points
Fixing uncompletable quests
Improving reward distribution

Thank you for your patience and support! Please continue to report any issues you encounter in our community hub.
We will keep working hard to improve your gaming experience!
—The "I Don't Want to Be a Villainess!" Dev Team
Note: This update should automatically download when you launch the game.

notes.title: "I Won't Be a Villainess Anymore!" - Major Update 2.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTE: If you encounter any errors when launching the game, please navigate to the installation directory, open the game_win folder, and run game.exe directly. Currently there may be issues receiving SMS verification codes, so players unable to update through normal channels can use this method as a temporary solution.[/b][/h1]
We are delighted to announce that "I Won't Be a Villainess Anymore!" has received a major content update! This lady has graciously provided a wealth of new storylines, character interactions, and brand-new systems to make your life at Winston Academy even more colorful!
[h2] ✨ New Events and Special Stories[/h2]
[h3]🔍 Friendship Events Explosion[/h3]
【Friendship Event】Bag Snatcher - When Alice gets her bag snatched at the school gate, will you heroically step in or stay out of it? Your choice will affect your future sisterhood!
【Outdoor Activity】Camping Adventure - An unexpected encounter with Dante during the class camping trip leads to forest exploration (and watching a wilderness survival novice struggle)
【Social Challenge】Birthday Party - Show off your wit and grace in a social showdown with other young ladies at Ryan's birthday party
🏫 Student Council Commission System (aka the Ryan & Agnes Harassment System)

The new Student Council Commission System is officially online! Hang around the Student Council with legitimate reasons, earn reputation and grades
12 special interaction scenes with Ryan and Agnes - see if you can tear off the Council President's mask of kindness!
Unlock hidden dialogues and special rewards while exploring the Student Council's untold secrets

🍰 Café Management System (From Broke to Rich)

Take over a café near campus and experience the glamorous transformation from "broke student" to "landlady"
Unique management gameplay lets this lady show you what real business acumen looks like!
Gain a stable source of income and never worry about the landlord knocking for rent again!

🌟 Mysterious New Character Debut
🎹 Mason Croud

Identity: Student Council Advisor, Music Department Genius Senior (Suspicion Level: MAX!)
Personality: Elegant and mysterious, well-mannered yet always appearing unexpectedly
Features: Why does he appear in the shadows of the library? Why does he always smile meaningfully? What undisclosed connection does he have with Winston Academy?

[h2] 🎮 System Optimizations and New Features[/h2]
🌱 Life Skills System Improvements

Fishing System - Sit elegantly by the pond, pretending you're not just daydreaming but actually have the patience to fish
Gardening System - Who says a young lady can't grow vegetables?! Watch as I grow the most delicious strawberries in school!

🔄 Optimizations and Fixes

Optimized the overall game flow, making your villain redemption journey smoother
Fixed multiple known bugs; you'll no longer experience the tragedy of "mysteriously being sent to a boarding school abroad"
Improved the UI interface to make this lady look even more radiant!

💘 Future Plans Preview
We are working diligently to develop more exciting content:

New romance options and special endings (Yes, this lady will conquer even more hearts!)
Seasonal events and dating system (Who says villains can't fall in love?!)
More life skills and campus challenges await your challenge!


Thank you to all players for your continued support and feedback! We hope you continue to accompany Emily Hartley on her journey from "villainess" to "exemplary graduate"! After all, this young lady is destined to become a campus legend!
"I Won't Be a Villainess Anymore!" Development Team
February 25, 2025
